tools.name: get_sales_performance
tools.description: WooCommerce sales metrics from the order-stats table: order count, gross revenue, shipping, tax, net revenue and AOV. Use 'interval' to choose an aggregate summary or a time-bucketed trend. Defaults to a summary over the last 30 days when dates are omitted.

interval.description: 'summary' returns a single aggregate row. 'hourly', 'daily' and 'monthly' return a time-bucketed trend.

tools.name: get_marketing_attribution
tools.description: UTM marketing attribution from WooCommerce order-attribution metadata. 'source_cleaned' groups revenue by normalised traffic source (Instagram, Facebook, Google, ...); 'campaign_leaderboard' ranks UTM campaigns by revenue; 'attribution_coverage' reports what share of orders carry any attribution data. Last 30 days by default.

tools.name: get_product_analytics
tools.description: Product-level analytics from the order-product lookup table. 'top_selling_items' ranks products/variations by net revenue; 'product_affinities' surfaces items frequently bought together (across all history, ignores dates); 'catalog_dictionary' lists published products with their IDs. Last 30 days by default.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-200).

tools.name: get_customer_insights
tools.description: Customer analytics. 'geography' breaks orders/revenue/AOV down by shipping city and country; 'retention_cohorts' reports first-time vs repeat buyers; 'repurchase_intervals' measures the cadence between repeat orders (average/fastest/longest days between purchases for returning customers). City and country only — no personal identifiers. 'geography'/'retention_cohorts' default to the last 30 days; 'repurchase_intervals' defaults to the last 365 days.

limit.description: Maximum rows for the 'geography' view (1-200). Ignored by 'retention_cohorts' and 'repurchase_intervals'.

tools.name: get_technical_analytics
tools.description: Device, OS and payment-method analytics parsed from order user-agent metadata. 'device_types' splits Mobile/Tablet/Desktop; 'os_types' splits Windows/MacOS/Android/iOS; 'os_x_payment' crosses OS against payment method. Last 30 days by default.

tools.name: get_inventory_runway
tools.description: Stock runway per product: current stock level against 30-day sales velocity, yielding estimated days until stockout. Runway is null for products with no sales in the last 30 days. Always uses a trailing 30-day window (no date parameters).

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1-100), ordered by sales velocity.

tools.name: get_coupon_leakage
tools.description: Coupon discount analysis: usage count, total discount given, gross and net revenue on orders using each coupon, and the discount's share of gross revenue (margin drain %). Ranked by discount volume. Last 30 days by default.

limit.description: Maximum number of coupons to return (1-200).
